name: se7enxweb/ezodf
description: Documents in and out of Exponential: imports Word, OpenDocument, RTF, PDF, Markdown, HTML, spreadsheets and presentations (files, folders, ZIP archives, web addresses) and exports any item as DOCX, PDF, ODT, RTF, EPUB or text, with LibreOffice as the converter, installed and switched on from the administration

suggest.se7enxweb/expqueue: Runs imports, exports and the converter's work on the job queue; without it each job runs in a PHP process of its own
suggest.se7enxweb/sqliimport: Document formats of 7x SQLI Import 2: mapping, dry run, undo and schedules for documents of uploads, ZIP archives, web addresses, feeds, WebDAV/Nextcloud, Google Drive, OneDrive and mailboxes
suggest.se7enxweb/expai: AI suggestions for imported documents (a summary and keywords), applied only on request
suggest.ext-curl: Installs LibreOffice from the administration and reads web addresses
